question: May this hardening intentionally reject existing mismatched-UID artifact directories and change the published meaning of `recorderPath`, or must the branch preserve upgrade compatibility?
rationale: The correct code depends on maintainer intent for the artifact schema and the security-versus-upgrade policy; tests cannot decide whether existing consumers and installations may be broken.

options.title: Preserve compatibility
options.body: Keep `recorderPath` stable, add a separate versioned snapshot field, and provide a safe explicit ownership recovery path for existing installations.

options.title: Adopt a breaking contract
options.body: Version the readiness schema, document required ownership and consumer migrations, and provide real upgrade proof before merging the intentional break.

recommendation.title: Preserve compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep `recorderPath` stable, add a separate versioned snapshot field, and provide a safe explicit ownership recovery path for existing installations.
